summary: This 46.8" mid-century modern coffee table features a tempered glass top with a decorative frame, two hidden storage drawers, and a floating base. Its rounded corners and soft rectangular form make it a safe, stylish choice for living rooms and apartments.
key_selling_points: Soft rectangular form with rounded corners for safety
Stunning glass and frame table top with layered visual interest
Modern floating base design for an airy look and easy cleaning
Discreet dual storage drawers for clutter-free organization
Thoughtful design combining beauty, safety, and practicality
description_html:
Key Selling Points

  • SOFT RECTANGULAR FORM WITH ROUNDED CORNERS: This table features an elegant rectangular silhouette softened by delicately curved edges on all sides. The refined rounded detailing breaks away from the harsh lines of traditional rectangular tables, creating a gentler, more inviting appearance while effectively preventing accidental bumps—making it an exceptionally safe choice for homes with children or elderly family members.
  • STUNNING GLASS AND FRAME TABLE TOP: The table surface masterfully combines a shaped top panel with tempered glass, surrounded by an elegant decorative border. The crystal-clear transparency of the glass beautifully contrasts with the dimensional frame detailing, creating layered visual interest and sophisticated light play from every viewing angle.
  • MODERN FLOATING BASE DESIGN: A sleek floating base elevates the entire piece, creating an airy, contemporary aesthetic that makes any room feel more spacious. This architectural foundation not only adds visual lightness but also makes cleaning underneath effortless and convenient.
  • DISCREET DUAL STORAGE DRAWERS: Two cleverly concealed drawers offer practical hidden storage for remote controls, coasters, charging cables, or other living room essentials. Keep your space clutter-free while maintaining the table's clean, minimalist appearance.
  • THOUGHTFUL DESIGN FOR MODERN LIVING: Every element of this table is crafted with both style and functionality in mind. From the child-safe rounded corners to the artistic glass-and-frame top and the space-enhancing floating base, this piece delivers beauty, safety, and practicality in one harmonious design.
